definitions.full: H8048. Shammah II. שַׁמָּה proper name, masculine 1. in Edom Gen 36:13 , 17 ; 1Chr 1:37 usually Σομε . 2 third son of Jesse 1Sam 16:9 ; 17:13 , Σαμ ( μ ) α , ᵐ5 L Σαμαα ; see שִׁמְעִי שִׁמְעָה, שִׁמְעָא, . 3 Σαμαια ( ς ) , etc., heroes of David: a. 2Sam 23:11 (omitted accidentally || 1Chr 11:13 Dr), 11:33 . b. 1Chr 11:25 = שַׁמּוֺת 11:27 , Σαμαωθ , Σαμ ( μ ) ωθ ; probably also שַׁמְהוּת 27:8 . p 1030, 1035
